items.html: Afterward, Hesed emerged and the vessel broke and fell into Bina of Beria, and the light came down to the place of the vessel of Yesod of Atzilut, since the light of Daat had already preceded to take the place of Malchut. Afterward, Gevura emerged and broke, and the vessel fell into Hochma of Beria, and the light came down into the vessel of Netzah-Hod of Atzilut, which are the two flanks of the Guf. Afterward, Tifferet emerged and broke, and the vessel fell into Keter of Beria, and the light remained in its place, which is in Tifferet of Atzilut.
